title: limonium divaricatum
intro: Limonium divaricatum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Spike Sea Lavender, is a plant species in the Plumbaginaceae family. The plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help in treating wounds and skin conditions. Limonium divaricatum is also reported to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities, contributing to its potential use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
